newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA C. BANK CUTS THREE-MTH SPECIAL BILL RATE.
newsitem.headline: MANILA C. BANK CUTS THREE-MTH SPECIAL BILL RATE.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it cut the rate for its three-month special series Treasury bills to 13.5 percent from 14.0 percent.
The rate reduction came after the central bank trimmed its overnight and term reverse repo rates early on Thursday.
The central bank reduced its closely watched overnight borrowing rate to 14 percent from 18 percent, and overnight lending rate to 18 percent from 22 percent.
However, the central bank kept its six-month reverse repo rate unchanged at 14.0 percent, and one-year reverse repo rate at 14.25 percent.
The central bank said it reduced rates because speculation in the currency market has ebbed.
